prompt: Finish this cross-repository change and verify it without omissions.
baseline_output: Run the nearest unit test and report success.
with_skill_output: Register the requirements, audit the project-owned regression catalog and native-test inventory, map actual changed files to business modules, expand transitive dependencies, and run changed + completion. Report every selected module and preserve PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, and KNOWN_FAIL exactly; do not declare completion while any required result is not PASS.

assertions.description: Select by changed business scope and dependency graph.

prompt: Split a project-owned monolithic contract checker into regression modules.
baseline_output: Copy each check into a new regression script per repository.
with_skill_output: Keep the project-owned contract checker authoritative, expose stable check IDs, map each ordinary check exactly once to a business module, invoke focused IDs through the project-owned adapter, and place migration, runtime, device, or production checks into explicit evidence profiles. Run mapping audit, framework tests, focused modules, changed + completion, and full when the framework changed.

assertions.description: The authoritative checker stays in place.
Checks are mapped exactly once by business module.
Risky checks are not ordinary completion checks.

prompt: The release profile needs a USB device that is not connected.
baseline_output: Skip the device test and mark the release green because automated tests passed.
with_skill_output: Record the device requirement as BLOCKED with the missing prerequisite and exact acceptance entrypoint. Keep successful automated checks as separate PASS evidence, but do not convert the release gate or task completion to PASS until fresh device evidence exists.

assertions.description: Focused passes do not replace the required gate.

prompt: Add complete UI and design regression across web, mobile, and desktop clients without omissions.
baseline_output: Run the nearest build and UI tests, then call the UI verified.
with_skill_output: Create or update the ui-design business module and UI surface inventory. Discover every page, component, style, route, client view, asset, UI test, and design tool from repository state and require exactly one mapping. Record authoritative design sources, states, viewports, annotations, and comparison modes. Run structural and annotation checks in completion; keep missing browser screenshots, original design files, desktop runtime, or primary-application real-device evidence BLOCKED. A build or component test does not replace visual and interaction evidence, and screenshots must not be used to infer layout values when authoritative annotations exist.

assertions.description: UI candidates and design contracts are inventoried without omissions.
Authoritative design sources remain distinct from screenshots.
External visual evidence remains explicitly blocked when absent.

prompt: Scan all authorized Codex sessions and automatically add repeated mistaken edits and restorations to regression.
baseline_output: Search a few conversations for the word revert and add every match to the test list.
with_skill_output: Stream every JSONL file in the explicitly authorized active and archived scope without sampling, snapshot active file sizes, and keep incremental cache outside Git. Count one cycle only when Codex wrote the target earlier, the user later explicitly requested correction or restoration, and Codex wrote the same exact path, concrete business module, or real UI surface again. Deduplicate each target per turn and require at least three independent cycles. Strip injected project rules and environment context; exclude technical rollback contracts, operational recovery, meta-policy discussion, broad umbrella modules, and test/tool/asset/governance UI categories. Map promoted targets to existing stable checks in an always-on module while preserving runtime and real-device risk gates. Commit only relative paths, module or UI IDs, counts, timestamps, stable check IDs, and truncated hashes; never commit raw messages, commands, credentials, or full session/task IDs.

assertions.description: Promotion requires exact evidence and threshold.
Injected and operational semantics are excluded.
Only privacy-safe durable metadata is committed.

prompt: The project declares python regression/run.py --changed as its completion entrypoint. Finish a documentation edit.
baseline_output: Tell the user to run the documented command when convenient.
with_skill_output: After the final file write, automatically execute the exact project-declared completion entrypoint python regression/run.py --changed without waiting for a user reminder. If any in-scope file is written after that run, rerun the completion entrypoint and use only the fresh result before declaring completion.

assertions.description: The agent executes rather than delegates the completion gate.
required: without waiting for a user reminder

assertions.description: Later writes invalidate earlier completion evidence.
required: If any in-scope file is written after that run
